messages:
maria_cs: Quick sync — Cerulean goes live on Dedicated next Tue (03/22). We need final quota plan, autoscale baseline, and a dry-run load test. Who can own?

sam_infra: I can lead quota sizing. Can you share expected p95 latency target and peak rps?

maria_cs: p95 target 350ms, peak steady-state 180 rps, burst to 600 rps for <15m. customer will use batching at 8 tokens avg.

liam_sre: For autoscale: recommend start min=4 pods, max=40, scale window 60s, cool-down 120s. Want to run a scrubbed dry-run against staging dedicated pool first.

anya_ps: I can run the dry-run script and capture the token cost delta + error rates. Need creds + route info from eng. Also will drive the customer-facing playbook.

ops-bot: Reminder: Dedicated quota change request created #Q-4872, approver: @tara_eng. ETA approval 24h. :bell:

tara_eng: Reviewing the quota request now. Two asks: (1) confirm model variant we'll pin (gpt-neox-20b-q4) and (2) will Cerulean accept degraded model fallback?

maria_cs: Confirm model variant gpt-neox-20b-q4. Customer prefers graceful fallback to smaller 6B if latency >800ms for >2m. Include in routing policy.

sam_infra: For load test I'll use the canary harness. Proposed command:
```bash
heyperf --target /v1/generate --qps 180 --concurrency 24 --duration 10m --headers 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>'
```
We'll run one steady-state and one burst profile.

liam_sre: Add KV cache warmup step before tests: send 500 prefills of common prefixes to avoid cold-cache spikes. If anyone has sample prefixes from Cerulean, drop them here.

oliver_cust: sharing a short set of real prefixes now (sanitized): "Order status", "Account balance", "Schedule meeting", "Refund policy" — use these in warmup.

anya_ps: I'll collect baseline metrics: p50/p95/p99 latencies, 95th token cost, error rate, autoscale events, and rollback criteria. I'll post the runbook and a TL;DR for the customer before the dry-run.

maria_cs: Great. Action items: Sam: quota numbers + test start time. Liam: warmup script + rollback hooks. Anya: metrics dashboard panel + playbook. Tara: approve Q-4872. Ops-bot will ping for approvals. Target dry-run: tomorrow 09:00 PT. :thumbsup:

sam_infra: Ack. I'll post exact VM/pool allocations by EOD and kick off the steady test tomorrow 09:00 PT.

liam_sre: I'll prepare an autoscale override that can be flipped if OOMs or latency spikes. Will also enable trace sampling = 5% during test.

ops-bot: Approval Q-4872 updated to 'pending final review' (approver: tara_eng).

tara_eng: Approved Q-4872. Noted fallback routing config and max pods.

maria_cs: Thanks all. I'll send the customer-facing schedule + playbook once Anya posts metrics panels.

anya_ps: Posting runbook link in a sec + panel screenshots after the first steady run.

maria_cs: Closing thread for now — will reopen if any blockers. :rocket:
